api/src/services/execution/__init__.py.name: Execution package
api/src/services/execution/__init__.py.description: Brings together the parts that run workflow and script code for the platform.

api/src/services/execution/agent_helpers.name: Agent setup helpers
api/src/services/execution/agent_helpers.description: Prepares an agent's instructions and tools, and lets one agent hand work to another.

api/src/services/execution/agent_run_acc.name: Who sees agent runs
api/src/services/execution/agent_run_acc.description: Limits agent run records to the people allowed to see them.

api/src/services/execution/agent_run_dis.name: Handing off agent runs
api/src/services/execution/agent_run_dis.description: Moves an agent run from waiting to a worker that will run it, and releases it if that worker never starts.

api/src/services/execution/agent_run_ser.name: Agent run lifecycle
api/src/services/execution/agent_run_ser.description: Queues agent runs, waits for their results, and stops or closes them cleanly.

api/src/services/execution/agent_workflo.name: Agent workflow launches
api/src/services/execution/agent_workflo.description: Checks an agent may use a bound workflow, then starts it and keeps the evidence it returns.

api/src/services/execution/async_executo.name: Queuing runs
api/src/services/execution/async_executo.description: Accepts workflow and short-script runs and hands them to background processing.

api/src/services/execution/autonomous_ag.name: Agent runner
api/src/services/execution/autonomous_ag.description: Runs an agent step by step without a chat window, calling its tools and handling delegated child agents.

api/src/services/execution/backfill_trac.name: Backfill progress
api/src/services/execution/backfill_trac.description: Keeps count of a summary backfill's progress and cost, and reports it as the batch moves along.
api/src/services/execution/backfill_trac.review: new exports: refresh_backfill_progress; removed exports: record_backfill_outcome

api/src/services/execution/cpu_sampler.p.name: CPU and memory sampling
api/src/services/execution/cpu_sampler.p.description: Measures how much processor and memory a running workflow actually uses.

api/src/services/execution/dry_run.py.name: Prompt comparison test
api/src/services/execution/dry_run.py.description: Tests a proposed agent instruction against a past run to see whether it would have decided differently.

api/src/services/execution/engine.py.name: Execution engine
api/src/services/execution/engine.py.description: Runs workflows, scripts and data sources in one place and reports their logs, resource use and result.

api/src/services/execution/import_restri.name: Customer code isolation
api/src/services/execution/import_restri.description: Stops customer code from reaching into the platform's internals while still allowing the approved tools.

api/src/services/execution/install_progr.name: Fleet install progress
api/src/services/execution/install_progr.description: Collects how each worker is doing during a fleet-wide install and shows one combined progress line.

api/src/services/execution/memory_monito.name: Memory watch
api/src/services/execution/memory_monito.description: Reads how much memory the container is using so the platform can avoid running out.

api/src/services/execution/model_selecti.name: Choosing the AI model
api/src/services/execution/model_selecti.description: Picks which AI model to use for summarising runs and for tuning suggestions.

api/src/services/execution/module_loader.name: Loading workflow code
api/src/services/execution/module_loader.description: Finds, loads and reads the details of workflows and data sources from the saved workspace.

api/src/services/execution/oom_priority..name: Memory sacrifice order
api/src/services/execution/oom_priority..description: Marks the work process as the first to be stopped when memory runs short, protecting the executors.

api/src/services/execution/process_pool..name: Isolated process pool
api/src/services/execution/process_pool..description: Keeps a supply of separate processes so each run stands alone and one bad run cannot take down the platform.

api/src/services/execution/queue_tracker.name: Queue positions
api/src/services/execution/queue_tracker.description: Shows where each waiting run sits in line so people can see roughly when theirs will start.

api/src/services/execution/requirements_.name: Package setup entry
api/src/services/execution/requirements_.description: Runs the package installation step for a worker in its own separate process.

api/src/services/execution/requirements_.name: Package setup results
api/src/services/execution/requirements_.description: Records which packages installed cleanly and which failed during worker setup.

api/src/services/execution/run_metadata..name: Run notes
api/src/services/execution/run_metadata..description: Lets an agent attach short notes to a run while leaving the platform's own fields untouched.

api/src/services/execution/run_summarize.name: Run summaries
api/src/services/execution/run_summarize.description: Writes a short account of what an agent was asked, what it did and how confident it was.

api/src/services/execution/service.py.name: Running workflows and code
api/src/services/execution/service.py.description: Starts a workflow, short script or data source and returns its result.

api/src/services/execution/simple_worker.name: Worker package install
api/src/services/execution/simple_worker.description: Installs a workspace's extra packages in a worker process and keeps going if one package fails.

api/src/services/execution/summary_dispa.name: Summary hand-off
api/src/services/execution/summary_dispa.description: Queues, claims and retries the work of summarising agent runs.
api/src/services/execution/summary_dispa.review: new exports: SummaryOwnershipLost, summary_owner_session, release_summary, fail_remote_summary

api/src/services/execution/template_proc.name: Warm worker template
api/src/services/execution/template_proc.description: Keeps a prepared process ready so new runs start quickly from a known state.

api/src/services/execution/tuning_servic.name: Agent tuning conversations
api/src/services/execution/tuning_servic.description: Runs the back-and-forth that helps an owner improve an agent's instructions, then applies the agreed changes.

api/src/services/execution/type_inferenc.name: Parameter descriptions
api/src/services/execution/type_inferenc.description: Reads a workflow's settings from its code so forms can show the right fields and choices.

api/src/services/execution/virtual_impor.name: Loading saved code
api/src/services/execution/virtual_impor.description: Loads a workspace's code from saved storage rather than disk, so every worker runs the current version.

api/src/services/execution/worker_sdk_ht.name: Worker tool access
api/src/services/execution/worker_sdk_ht.description: Gives a running workflow its own private route to platform tools without going through the public server.

api/src/services/execution/worker.py.name: Worker run core
api/src/services/execution/worker.py.description: Runs one piece of work in its own process and records its time, memory and result.

api/src/services/execution/workflow_disp.name: Workflow run hand-off
api/src/services/execution/workflow_disp.description: Accepts a workflow run durably, hands it to an executor, and reclaims it if that executor disappears.

api/src/services/execution/workspace_mod.name: Code cache refresh
api/src/services/execution/workspace_mod.description: Clears out old loaded code when the workspace changes, so reused processes run the current version.
